GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (20 May 47) LS-R
(SCAPIN - 1691)
APO 500
20 May 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Suspected War Criminal.
Memorandum to the Imperial Japanese Government dated 6 Nov 45, file AG 000.5 (6 Nov 45) LS-R, wherein the Imperial Japanese Government was directed to deliver one NAKAGAWA, Yukihiro, Yonin (HQ), to the Commanding General, EIGHTH Army at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp), at the earliest possible date, is amended to delete said NAKAGAWA's name for the reason that he was mistaken for NAKAGAWA, Tatsuo, who is presently in Sugamo Prison. This name appears as the eighth name on Page No. 10, of the above mentioned Memorandum.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R. M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
